title: Payment Arrangements Desk Guide — Re-aging Method and the Term Window
content:
When an installment of a plan under Payment Arrangements is re-aged by a deferral, the re-aging method — and with it the regular installment after the change — follows the plan's term window.

## Rule

The re-aging method is not settled until the installment history carries the missed entry of the installment being re-aged.

The re-aging method follows the plan's term window:

1. When the re-aged installment, placed one period after the plan's current final installment, still falls within the extended term window, it is appended there and the regular installment is unchanged.
2. When it does not, and fewer than 3 installments follow the re-aged installment, the re-aged remainder is spread evenly over those installments and the re-aged installment's own new place together, the share rounded up to the type's rounding unit: the regular installment after the change is the regular installment plus the re-aged remainder divided by the number of following installments plus one.
3. Otherwise the re-aged remainder is spread evenly over the installments that follow the re-aged installment: the regular installment after the change is the regular installment plus the re-aged remainder divided by the number of those installments, the share rounded up to the type's rounding unit.

The placed installment falls within the term window when the calendar days from the term window start to its placed date are no more than the term window. One period after the current final installment is seven days later for a weekly plan, fourteen days later for a biweekly plan and the same day of the following month for a monthly plan. The installments that follow the re-aged installment number the plan's installment count less the re-aged installment's number less one.

## Decision table

| Placed date within the term window | Installments following the re-aged installment | Regular installment after the change |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Any | Unchanged |
| No | 0, 1 or 2 | Regular installment plus the remainder divided by (following installments plus one), share rounded up |
| No | 3 or more | Regular installment plus the remainder divided by the following installments, share rounded up |

## Worked figures (hypothetical: regular installment 200.00, re-aged remainder 140.00, rounding unit 1.00)

- Placed date inside the term window, 6 installments following: appended; the regular installment stays 200.00.
- Placed date outside the term window, 2 installments following: 140.00 divided by 3 is 46.67, rounded up to 47.00; the regular installment becomes 247.00.
- Placed date outside the term window, 6 installments following: 140.00 divided by 6 is 23.33, rounded up to 24.00; the regular installment becomes 224.00.
- Exactly 3 installments following, outside the window: 3 is not fewer than 3, so 140.00 is divided by 3 alone, 46.67 rounded up to 47.00, giving 247.00.
